I haven't added `clever k8s activity` yet. You declined the permission to create the command file, so I undid my one other edit (registering it in `src/commands/global.commands.js`), and the working tree is clean again.

Most of the work is already in the repo. `src/lib/k8s.js` has a `k8sListActivity(orgIdOrName, clusterIdOrName, limit)` helper. It calls the `listK8sDeploymentEvents` request in `src/clever-client/k8s.js` (`GET .../clusters/{clusterId}/deployment-events`). No command uses either one yet.

Here is what I was going to add, modelled on `k8s get` and `k8s list`:

- **New file `src/commands/k8s/k8s.activity.command.js`:** `clever k8s activity <cluster-id|cluster-name>` with `--org`, an optional `--limit <limit>` (a positive integer passed to the API), `--format human|json` and `since: null`. JSON output prints the raw events. Human output prints a table with date, event, status and message, or "🔎 No activity found for this cluster" if there are none.
- **Registry:** add `activity: k8sActivityCommand` under `k8s` in `global.commands.js`.
- **Finish:** run `npm run docs` to regenerate `k8s.docs.md` and the skill reference, update `skills/clever-tools/SKILL.md` if it lists the k8s subcommands, then run `npm run validate`.

The repo doesn't document the fields of a deployment event. My draft guesses them (`createdAt`/`date`, `type`/`event`, `status`/`state`, `message`) with fallbacks. To get them right I'd run the read-only `clever k8s activity` on a real cluster, with the `k8s` flag turned on through a temporary `EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES_FILE`. If you know the response shape, tell me and I'll use it.
